zoe: Quick heads-up 1 config-only tweak for chat-v2 routing weights + batching tonight. Canary 3% for 15m. No model binaries.

mike: Which knobs? Any impact to dedicated tenants?

zoe: Changing route_priority to favor short messages, increase max_batch_size 12->18, and lower batch_window_ms 20->10 to reduce latency for short chats. Applies to hosted + dedicated routing policies; pinned model: chat-v2@2026-04-12 for dedicated.

tara: Add auto-fallback if error_rate > 1% over 3m: switch traffic for affected tenant slice to chat-v2-legacy. Also please run a quick staging preflight.

zoe: ACK. Pushing YAML to canary bundle. Snippet:
```yaml
routing:
  route: chat-v2
  model_pin: "chat-v2@2026-04-12"
  route_priority: small-first
batching:
  max_batch_size: 18
  batch_window_ms: 10
failover:
  on_error_pct: 1.0
  window_mins: 3
  route_to: chat-v2-legacy
```

deploy-bot: Queued `/deploy-config --service=routing --change=shortflow-batch-tweak --canary=0.03 --duration=15m --pin=model:chat-v2@2026-04-12`

sre-oncall: Noting a scheduled autoscaler tweak in ap-south at +8m. Recommend excluding ap-south from canary or delaying by 10m.

zoe: Excluding ap-south from initial canary and starting now.

deploy-bot: Canary started at 6270001125 1 regions: all except ap-south. Monitoring hooks: p95 latency, errors, mem, kv-cache hit. Auto-fail: error_rate > 1% for 3m.

mike: Staging preflight looks clean. perf snapshot: p50=105ms, p95=420ms, errors=0, mem +2%.

zoe: t+10m check 1 no error increase, p95 stable, small-request throughput improved. Proceed to ramp to 25% in 5m.

sre-oncall: ap-south autoscaler change completed; safe to include.

deploy-bot: Ramping to 25% at 6270001155 and adding ap-south.

mike: No regressions on top-level customer metrics. Token cost down ~4%.

zoe: Will keep watch for 30m then schedule full rollout if green. Adding note to release digest: https://redwood.internal/changes/6270001110-shortflow-batch.

deploy-bot: Thread closed at 6270001165 1 config active at 25% (scheduled full roll if metrics remain green).
